answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one canyon weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 276 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 120 times the capital for one share. The oasis report reveals the merge explicitly at each dune. A farm of 3739 identities would post 898 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
